description: COMBINE the new global best (brief 10 HEAD 7f589ebe, 5706us — tensor-core inner panel + n=2048 batched-panel extension, but trailing GEMMs are still FP32) with brief 8's per-matrix classify-on-convert TF32 trailing routing (a1882a4e). Brief 8 proved the TF32 trailing GEMM saves ~1500us at n=512 and ~1080us at n=1024 vs FP32 SIMT, with the win unmasked by a CUSTOM warp-per-row classify_kernel (144us, not torch's 1473us abs/amax/amin reductions) routing well-conditioned matrices to TF32 and band/rowscale/mixed-ill to FP32 (ill MUST stay FP32; 2xTF32 band 25.2>20). Port that cheap classifier + TF32-well/FP32-ill trailing routing onto the current best's trailing GEMMs for n in {512,1024,2048}; keep the panel and n>=4096->geqrf unchanged. Avoid the substring 'stream' anywhere incl. comments.

Trial 1 KEEPER (BEST): COMBINE delivered — parent B's per-matrix classifier + TF32(well)/FP32(ill) trailing routing ported onto parent A's fast 2-level panel for n in {512,1024}; n=2048 all-TF32 (unchanged). Geomean 5340.34us = 1.069x over parent A 5706.14, 24.56x over baseline 131187. ALL 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN (n512 band scaled_factor 14.3<20 stays FP32; n512 dense 3.97 on TF32). nsys n512 dense: panel_factor<128> 64.6pct, trailing GEMMs now genuine sm100_tensorop_tf32gemm ~33pct (ZERO simt_sgemm), classify_kernel 1.7pct (142us). Per-shape: n512 dense 8771, n1024 dense 9352, n512 rankdef 8588, n512 clustered 8727, n512 mixed 9729, n1024 mixed 10490, n1024 nearrank 9339, n2048 19183, n4096 52303.

Trial 2: A/B mixed strategy = fp32-whole-batch (vs trial-1 reorder). REGRESSION 5383.74 vs 5340.34. Mixed shapes regress: n512 mixed 9729->10501 (+772us), n1024 mixed 10490->10621 (+131us); other shapes flat (noise). Reorder+split-GEMM-at-boundary still beats FP32-fallback for heterogeneous batches even on the faster 2-level panel — parent B's reorder finding holds. Reverting MIXED_STRATEGY to reorder.

Trial 3: FP16 well-group trailing GEMM (vs trial-1 TF32). BIG REGRESSION 6868 vs 5340. n512 dense 8771->14589 (+5818us), n1024 dense 9352->13919: the per-panel V.half()/C.half()/.float() cast kernels of the full m x tcols trailing block cost far more than FP16's 2x tensor-core peak buys. Numerically valid (n512 dense scaled 4.11<20, all 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN) but slow. CONFIRMS TF32 is the right well-mode (no input cast needed, just allow_tf32 on FP32 inputs). Reverting WELL_MODE to tf32.

Trial 4 KEEPER (BEST, final): restored TF32 well-mode + reorder mixed (trial-1 winning config), documented A/B findings inline, decoupled n=2048 to explicit mode='tf32'. Geomean 5351.57us (3-run 5336-5352, ~5343 avg) = 1.066x over parent A 5706.14, 24.53x over baseline 131187. ALL 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. nsys n512 MIXED confirms per-matrix routing live: panel<128> 57.2pct, well-group trailing on sm100_tensorop_tf32gemm (~27pct: s256x256/s128x64/s128x128 tf32), ill-minority (band/rowscale) trailing on simt_sgemm FP32 (~12.5pct), reorder gather 4.7pct, classify_kernel 1.5pct (145us).

COMBINE DELIVERED. KEEPER dd7ea439: parent A's fast 2-level micro-panel kernel + n=2048 batched panel (kept BYTE-IDENTICAL) with parent B's per-matrix classify-on-convert TF32(well)/FP32(ill) trailing-GEMM routing ported on for n in {512,1024}; n=2048 all-TF32; n>=4096/off-grid -> geqrf (unchanged). Geomean 5351us (3-run 5336-5352, ~5343 avg) = 1.066x over parent A 5706, 24.53x over baseline 131187. ALL 22 tests + 3 guards (invariance/diff/offgrid) CLEAN.

THE BRIEF THESIS IS VINDICATED. nsys confirms the trailing GEMMs are now genuine sm100_tensorop_tf32gemm for the well majority (ZERO simt_sgemm on homogeneous well shapes) where parent A ran FP32 SIMT cutlass_sgemm. Per-shape vs parent A geomean 5706: the n>=512 well shapes all improved (n512 dense 8759, n1024 dense 9370, n512 rankdef 8615, n512 clustered 8753, n512 mixed 9741, n1024 mixed 10517, n1024 nearrank 9373). The classifier is cheap (classify_kernel 1.5-1.7pct, ~142-145us) so it does NOT mask the TF32 win. On n512 MIXED, nsys shows the split live: well group on tf32gemm (~27pct), ill band/rowscale on simt_sgemm FP32 (~12.5pct), reorder gather 4.7pct.

TRAJECTORY: T1 combine 5340 (KEEPER) -> T2 mixed=fp32 5384 (REGRESSION, reorder beats fp32-fallback even on faster panel) -> T3 well=fp16 6868 (BIG REGRESSION, per-panel half-casts of the full trailing block cost more than fp16's 2x peak buys; numerically valid though, n512 dense scaled 4.11<20) -> T4 5352 (restored TF32+reorder KEEPER, documented).

PRECISION FACTS RE-VERIFIED: well-conditioned n512 dense 3.97 on 1xTF32 (<<20 gate); ill n512 band 14.3 / rowscale 11.8 correctly kept FP32; n1024 dense 1.23 on TF32; n2048 rankdef 0.88 / mixed (test 17) 3.45 all-TF32. Classify-every-matrix passes the invariance guard (position+fraction sweeps all OK); sample-and-assume would fail.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (manager to weigh):
1) BIGGEST LEVER, OFF THIS BRIEF: panel_factor_kernel is now 57-65pct of the n512 time (the dominant wall). It is brief-0/7/10's lane, kept byte-identical here. A faster panel makes the TF32 trailing an even larger fraction and multiplies the geomean further. The 2-level micro-panel (IB=8) and 512-thread CTA are parent A's; a per-column-barrier / SMEM-occupancy attack or a wider IB sweep may still have headroom.
2) Mixed reorder gather of the full B*n*n H (nsys 4.7pct of n512 mixed, ~448us incl. both input permute + output inverse-permute) is the only remaining mixed-specific overhead, intrinsic to the reorder. A scatter-on-final-panel-write fusion in the panel kernel would remove the output inverse-permute (~half of it) -- but that is a panel-kernel change (off this brief's keep-panel-byte-identical constraint).
3) WELL-GROUP PANEL WIDTH: now that the well trailing is cheap TF32, a wider panel block (nb>32) means fewer panel+trailing round-trips for the well group -- but needs MAXCB>32 in the panel kernel (register-array + SMEM change), off this brief.
4) n=1024 ALL-TF32 (skip classify): the n1024 budget (factor_rtol 0.00244, 2x looser than n512) MIGHT admit uniform TF32 incl. band/rowscale in mixed batches -- NOT attempted here because it carries real correctness risk (the n1024 mixed benchmark shape contains band/rowscale matrices and the brief mandates they stay FP32); a careful validate-gated trial could confirm or refute the margin.
5) Tried and rejected (measured): well=fp16 (6868, half-casts too costly), mixed=fp32-fallback (5384, reorder wins). 2xTF32 for the ill path is ruled out by parent B (band 25.2>20). BF16x9 is remote-unsafe (do not use).
